title: Online integration: friend ghosts, block by player id, cloud medals
summary: The online features now meet: Lap Attack can race a friend's ghost, mute and block follow the player rather than the name, and medals travel in the Pass Key cloud save.
details: Friend ghosts: each online rider's personal best per course goes to the Worker under a tag derived from their player id (at most 32 per board). The Ghost row adds Friend, the quickest friend with a stored ghost.
Block and mute by verified id: a renamed rider stays blocked; a room block is also the identity block.
Cloud save: an additive medals block carries course best laps and weekly results and badges. Ghost blobs stay on the device. PR #668, part of #631.

Verification: extended tools/test_engine_ghost_challenges.mjs and tools/test_engine_multiplayer_chat.mjs. The PR body does not record a run result. Host-only evidence: browser tests on host Chromium against a local game server. Nothing was checked on physical phones.
limitation: There is no Friend choice offline, since friend tags come only through the game server. A friend who has not improved for a while can drop out of a busy board's 32 stored ghosts. A second device on the same Pass Key shows the medal but has no PB ghost until it rides one.
